name: Emelie
source:
She's the princess of "Hog Haven Kingdom" and the main love-interest of the protagonist. She's quite curious and open-minded to new experiences, a free soul of the sorts. She doesn't dislike her duties completely, but wouldn't like to be confined by them.
 At times she can be innocent and going with the flow, but on others she is more assertive and takes a more hands-on approach.
 Some of her interests are Humane Hunk, a popular novel that may influence some of the experiences that she will engage in. Another is to roam around the Kingdom while being able to be herself, and not just the princess.
